name: Market on 8th
notes: Market on 8th is a food hall; photos show two vendor menu boards (Carnitas Quiroga, a full printed taqueria menu, and Mama V's Lumpia, a Filipino stall). A third photo (a bar's joke 'optional upcharge' chalkboard) had no real dishes and was skipped. Sections below are prefixed by vendor. A handful of per-pound add-on lines with non-numeric pricing (e.g. 'extra per libra') and a couple of items with obscured prices were dropped or left priceless per the rules.
